note: Takhrij of al-Jami' al-Saghir read by eye from the printed pages where the machine reading lost, merged or garbled it. Key = the hadith number. k = the takhrij as printed (a question mark inside the brackets = a symbol the print itself does not make out); cut = the tail of the machine-read text that really belongs to the takhrij; none = the printed hadith has no source; natural = the words exactly as printed when they are not symbols.
